content:
**Ruled #750 option (b) — the softening reads the conclusion's CAUSE, not the finding count**

**What**: Maintainer ruled (b) for #750 (comment https://github.com/csrinaldi/brain/issues/750#issuecomment-5357386695): evaluators state WHY they concluded REVISE (`blocker` / `gate` / `uncomputable`); `buildVerdict`'s #483 softening (verdict.mjs:260 on feature/issue-682) softens only when the cause is blocker-driven and every blocker was routed out. An evaluator that declares no cause cannot be softened — fail-closed by construction. Option (a), a structured flag, was rejected: its default is fail-open until the criterion-5 audit completes, and it is one more line in the branch whose widening (#747) caused the last §10 regression.

**Why**: A verdict can render APPROVE while `conditions[]` says "evidence uncomputable" — §10 inverted. Live on main AND the tracker; pinned as KNOWN GAP at verdict.test.mjs:864 on the tracker.

**Where**: brain/scripts/review/verdict.mjs, evaluators/{checkpoint,tranche,ruling}.mjs, cli.mjs:450-658. Delivery: own SDD change `issue-750-softening-reads-the-cause`, chained slice on `feature/issue-682` (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-750), because the pin to replace lives in the tracker's test file and verdict.mjs diverged from main.

**Learned (measured)**: three evaluators produce REVISE; two can do it WITHOUT a blocker — tranche.mjs:161 (rollup uncomputable), tranche.mjs:197 (budget uncomputable), checkpoint.mjs:240 (third cause `uncomputableReasons`). ruling.mjs:127 always carries a blocker. #750's criterion 5 asks whether that set is complete; the exploration is auditing inferential/refuter/applyCausalAdmission.
